defillama.tvl_methodology: TVL is calculated as the sum of all Account values and the available balance in the liquidity pools. Assets are not double counted. (DefiLlama-stated.)

hack_history.fix_summary: V1 deprecated. V2 redesigned: explicit setAssetManager() opt-in + flashAction() health-check.

hack_history.amount_assets: USDC + USDS swapped to ~840 ETH equivalent and bridged to Ethereum
hack_history.vector: Rebalancer SwapLogic._swapViaRouter accepted arbitrary router address; attacker registered own contract as router. With msg.sender == Rebalancer, the malicious router could re-enter user accounts that whitelisted the Rebalancer and withdraw LP NFT positions.
hack_history.fix_summary: Router Trampoline pattern in new Rebalancer.sol; RebalanceLogic constrains rebalances to optimal swap through pool itself; AccountV3/V4 deployed; Sherlock audited 2025-09 and 2026-01.

recovery_program.mechanism: 1:1 USD claim ERC-20 redeemable from protocol fees; passive redemption via stART staking
